reviewSnippets: This is Dr. Thomas Swonke's clinic in the medical center. He's by far the best dentist I've ever been too! His staff is great too!
Dr. Swonke's hands-down the best dentist I've ever had. Just as important, as a patient, the staff here is top-notch. From reception, to the hygenists, and subs - the place just oozes competency. …

Dr. Swonke was recommended to me by 3 of my neighbors. He has been truly what they said he would be- I have every confidence in him. I’ve had some bad experiences in the past with dentists and I’m always stressed about going. Dr. Swonke …
